scope: Controlled paymentFailure checkout incidents on one local Astronomy Shop

traffic.source: Pinned upstream .env and load-generator source; retain actual runtime settings

incomplete_input_views.construction: Filter actual records by kind, then apply the same fixed selection to both methods. Never add invented records.
incomplete_input_views.analysis_unit: Original triplet; views and phases are dependent, not new independent incidents
incomplete_input_views.interpretation: A missing modality does not imply abstention is necessarily correct

required: No reduction in fault localization count on matched development cases
No increase in clean false-attribution count
Wrong fault attributions decrease, or a declared engineering defect is corrected
Raw and postprocessed results are both retained
retention_rule.confirmation: Freeze selected implementation and evaluator before two later fresh triplets; confirmation results do not drive selection

claim_support_rubric.supported: Each factual assertion in the reason resolves to captured content and the claimed direction follows the observed call relationship; distinguish plausible initiation from proven cause
claim_support_rubric.contradicted: At least one asserted fact or call direction conflicts with captured content
claim_support_rubric.insufficient: Available observations do not establish the assertion or distinguish a competing explanation
claim_support_rubric.adjudication: A simulated independent AI evidence audit can flag issues. It is not an expert user study or an independent human grounding score. Unreviewed cases remain not_assessed.

limitations: Capture acceptance conditions on visible evidence
